summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-08) 未发现符合条件的趋势信号。

commit_signals.title: Agent SDK V2 API 重构
commit_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 官方 Agent SDK 将核心方法从 `receive` 重命名为 `stream`，标志着 V2 Session API 的稳定化和标准化，影响所有基于该生态的开发者。

commit_signals.title: GitHub Actions 集成自定义分支
commit_signals.why_it_matters: 允许开发者通过模板自定义 AI 生成的分支名称，解决了 AI 编码工具在复杂 CI/CD 流程中的集成痛点，提升了自动化工作流的灵活性。

commit_signals.title: 多模态输入权限管理
commit_signals.why_it_matters: 在桌面端应用中显式添加音频和摄像头权限，反映了 AI Agent 从纯文本向多模态交互（语音、视觉）演进的趋势，同时也加强了对敏感硬件调用的控制。

commit_signals.title: Agent 技能系统中心化
commit_signals.why_it_matters: Google Gemini CLI 和 OpenAI Codex 同时在重构技能发现与管理逻辑，表明 Agent 架构正从单一脚本向可扩展、可插拔的技能系统演进，以支持更复杂的任务。

commit_signals.title: 工具输出截断与文件转储
commit_signals.why_it_matters: 针对 Agent 执行工具时产生大量输出导致上下文溢出的问题，引入了截断并写入文件的机制。这是解决长上下文窗口限制和 Token 成本问题的实用工程方案。

commit_signals.title: 结构化输出拒绝错误处理
commit_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain 引入特定的 `OpenAIRefusalError` 来处理模型拒绝生成结构化输出的情况。这提升了应用在处理敏感内容或安全拒绝时的鲁棒性。

commit_signals.title: 子代理模型路由机制
commit_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini CLI 引入子代理模型路由的初步变更，暗示了未来 Agent 架构将根据任务类型动态分配不同规模或能力的模型，以平衡性能与成本。

commit_signals.title: 异步工具调用支持
commit_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 框架增加异步工具使用支持，显著提高了 Agent 并行处理多个工具或 API 请求的能力，减少了等待延迟，提升了响应速度。

commit_signals.title: 人机交互全局配置
commit_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 引入全局流配置来管理人在回路反馈，使得在复杂的 Agent 工作流中统一干预和审核策略成为可能，增强了可控性。

commit_signals.title: Kotlin 语言支持插件化
commit_signals.why_it_matters: 通过 LSP 插件形式添加 Kotlin 支持，展示了 AI 编码助手通过标准化协议快速扩展对新语言支持的能力，降低了对特定语言深度集成的依赖。

releases.summary:
This week's release includes initial support for [Dev Containers](https://zed.dev/blog/dev-containers), a new [worktree trust mechanism](https://zed.dev/blog/secure-by-default), a new Tree view for the Git panel, SQL syntax highlighting in Python files, AI-generated commit messages that respect rules files (e.g. `AGENTS.md`), improved terminal scrolling and link detection, and a set of Helix mode keymap improvements.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added `save_file` and `restore_file_from_disk` agent tools to handle dirty buffers when editing files. ([#45005](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45005))
- Agent: Added a button to the agent thread view that scrolls to the most recent prompt. ([#44961](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44961))
- Agent: Added the ability to use `shift-tab` to cycle through profiles for the built-in Zed agent. ([#44979](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44979))
- Agent: Added the ability to delete a profile through the "Manage Profiles" modal. ([#44977](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44977))
- Agent: Improved agent panel performance when rendering large diffs. ([#44995](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44995))
- Agent: Improved the model search quality in the model picker. ([#44984](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44984))
- Agent: Added optional `timeout_ms` parameter to the terminal tool, allowing the agent to bound command runtime and prevent indefinite hangs. ([#44895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44895))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Disabled word completions in plaintext and markdown files. To re-enable, add the following to your settings: `"languages": { "Plain Text": { "completions": { "words": "enabled" } }, "Markdown": { "completions": { "words": "enabled" } } }`. ([#44654](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44654))
- Removed `editor::AcceptPartialEditPrediction` and replaced it with `editor::AcceptNextLineEditPrediction` and `editor::AcceptNextWordEditPrediction`. ([#44411](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44411); thanks [teleoflexuous](https://github.com/teleoflexuous))
- Changed Markdown Preview commands `markdown::MovePageUp` and `markdown::MovePageDown` to `markdown::ScrollPageUp` and `markdown::ScrollPageDown`. ([#44585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44585); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Vim: Removed a keybinding conflict between the default macOS bindings for `pane::ActivateItem` and the `ctrl-6` alias for `pane::AlternateFile` which is primarily bound to `ctrl-^`. `ctrl-6` is no longer treated as an alias for `ctrl-^` in vim mode. If you'd like to restore `ctrl-6` as a binding for `pane::AlternateFile`, paste the following into your `keymap.json` file. ([#44560](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44560))
